title: Expand /skills into a scoped four-state manager
objective: Expose list/show/set/reset/enable/disable/refresh over stable IDs, four visibility states, persistence scopes, and read-only ownership.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid skill catalog design in the dirty shared worktree.
Registry state is authoritative; prompt messages are an append-only model projection and never the authorization boundary.

source_evidence.note: Bounded metadata catalog and on-demand full skill content.
Live discovery and four-state skill visibility controls.
Append-only messages preserve the prior cached prefix.

include: List name, summary, stable ID, source, locator, digest, revision, visibility, state source, and mutability.
Support auto, name-only, manual-only, off plus legacy enable/disable aliases.
Support this-session and persistent scope plus reset-to-inherited.
Reject ambiguous bare names and managed read-only changes.
Define a shared SkillInvoker interface and invocation origin contract for TUI and screen-reader callers.

Define an InteractiveSkillsBackend that lists authoritative rows and exposes ToggleProjectVisibility(sessionID, stable SkillID, expected revision), delegating its one-call persist/live/rollback transaction to Manager.

Define the interactive UI toggle scope as project-local persistent override with immediate live-session application; reject an active session override with a typed actionable conflict rather than replacing it. Keep session-only and advanced visibility changes available through explicit text commands.
Ensure project-scoped text set/off operations update the same persisted last_non_off record consumed by the Space shortcut.

Use semantic i18n keys for every new user-visible command description, usage, state, source, conflict, rejection, degraded, and success message; provide translations for every i18n.AllLanguages language and extend focused catalog completeness tests.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Evolve SkillsBackend around the frozen contract while keeping legacy command registration compatible.
Implement text command behavior and stable usage/errors.
Add fake-backend tests for all states/scopes, name collisions, stale revisions, session-override conflicts, and committed/rejected/degraded toggle results.
acceptance_criteria: Every management action reports effective state and scope.
Persistent and session actions are distinguishable.
All discovered sources are viewable even when not mutable.
Explicit user invocation has a shared, origin-aware interface that does not bypass visibility policy.
The default interactive toggle scope is explicit and never silently changes between session-only and persistent behavior.
One interactive backend call accepts stable ID plus expected revision and returns the authoritative row/result after the complete persist-and-live transaction.
Requested state, effective state, state source, and rejected/degraded outcomes are distinguishable to UI callers.
risks: commands/skills.go is already user-modified; preserve existing behavior not explicitly replaced by the accepted design.
dispatch_prompt: Expand /skills to a stable-ID, four-state, scoped management command using a fakeable backend. Do not modify loader, UI, or runtime wiring.
notes_for_assignee: Respect owned_files. Escalate contract gaps to the integration owner rather than editing another task's production files.
